# Vulkan headers

Unmodified Khronos `vk_platform.h` and `vulkan_core.h` from tag `v1.2.162`:
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/tree/v1.2.162/include/vulkan

Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.txt and header copyright notices. Only core Vulkan 1.0
functions are used. The application loads the installed system Vulkan loader;
no loader or driver binary is redistributed here.
